tasks.prompt: Write solution.py implementing normalize_name(value: str) -> str: lowercase the input, replace every run of whitespace with a single hyphen, collapse every run of consecutive hyphens into a single hyphen, then strip leading/trailing hyphens. Examples: '  Hello   WORLD  ' -> 'hello-world', '--edge--case--' -> 'edge-case', 'A  B' -> 'a-b'. Use only the Python standard library.

Write solution.py implementing total_value(items_csv: str) -> float. The input is CSV text with lines of the form name,quantity,price (quantity is an integer, price is a decimal number). Return the sum of quantity * price over all non-blank lines. Blank lines (including a trailing newline) contribute nothing. Examples: 'widget,2,3.50\ngadget,1,10.00\n' -> 17.0, '' -> 0.0. Use only the Python standard library.

Write solution.py implementing is_balanced(s: str) -> bool that returns True exactly when every bracket in s is closed by the matching type in the correct order. Bracket types are (), [] and {}. Examples: '([]{})' -> True, '([)]' -> False (wrong order), '(((' -> False, '' -> True. Return real booleans. Use only the Python standard library.
